def: The running vector at each token position that every attention head and MLP reads from and adds to, and that the unembedding finally reads.
A property of the input, such as a token being a name, that a model represents as a direction in its activations.
A linear classifier trained on frozen activations to test whether a property can be read from them.
Copying an activation from one run of a model into another run and measuring how the output changes, to test whether that activation matters.
A network storing more sparse features than it has dimensions by packing them into overlapping directions.
A neuron that responds to several unrelated features, a common result of superposition.
A network trained to rebuild a layer's activations from a wide, mostly zero code, whose decoder directions are candidate features.
The output-value path of an attention head, which sets what the head writes into the residual stream.
A direction, or a few directions, in a vector space; components can use separate subspaces of the residual stream as private channels.
